# Test fixtures

`openstax_chapter.pdf` is committed (added in `fb8eb11`) and used by the
phase-1 acceptance integration test at
`tests/integration/test_parser_openstax.py`. The test is gated behind the
`integration` pytest marker, so the default `uv run pytest` run does not
exercise it.

To run the OpenStax parse test:

    uv run pytest -m integration tests/integration/test_parser_openstax.py

`tiny_test.pdf` is generated by `generate_tiny_pdf.py` and used by the
unit-test parser suite under `tests/unit/test_parser.py`.
